arStrings.szText: {c_highlight}Lunar Shrines{/c} surging with an immense and prosperous power are appearing throughout Sanctuary.
Defeat monsters while empowered by Lunar Shrines to earn {c_highlight}100% bonus Experience{/c} and unlock an infinite trove of {c_highlight}limited-time rewards{/c} from {c_highlight}Ying-Yue{/c}.
{c_highlight}Cleanse Lunar Shrines{/c} from miserly spirits to accelerate your favor with the ancestors.
